prompt: Maeve says you cannot take a horse out unless the gate (to be) shut.
explanation_ru: После unless в условии используется Present Simple (is), а не форма с will; смысл — «если ворота не закрыты».

prompt: Aleksandra will share her stall roof ___ we pay half the cost.
explanation_ru: As long as задаёт условие договорённости («при условии, что мы оплатим половину»). Частая ошибка — путать его с in case (предосторожность) или even if (уступка).

prompt: At Antoine's bakery, a new worker can use the main oven alone only if he (to prepare) forty loaves in an hour.
explanation_ru: После only if в правиле или реальном условии ставится Present Simple (prepares), без will.

prompt: I won't join the night street watch in our town ___ on Saturday or Sunday.
explanation_ru: Unless уже содержит отрицание («если не»), поэтому глагол после него стоит в утвердительном Present Simple (meets). Типичные ошибки — двойное отрицание (unless ... doesn't) и will после unless.

prompt: Krzysztof will not build the second water tank if the shop does not deliver the pipes by Friday. → Krzysztof will not build the second water tank unless …
answer: Krzysztof will not build the second water tank unless the shop delivers the pipes by Friday.
accepted_answers: Krzysztof will not build the second water tank unless the shop delivers the pipes by Friday.
Krzysztof won't build the second water tank unless the shop delivers the pipes by Friday.
explanation_ru: Unless заменяет if ... not, поэтому отрицание does not deliver уходит и глагол ставится в утвердительную форму delivers.

prompt: We can fix the torn theatre jacket before the show, provided the extra cloth (to arrive) by noon, so don't panic.
explanation_ru: После provided (при условии, что) для будущего условия используется Present Simple (arrives) или Present Perfect (has arrived), но не will.

prompt: Lukas lets me go home early as long as the bread will be ready.
answer: Lukas lets me go home early as long as the bread is ready.
accepted_answers: Lukas lets me go home early as long as the bread is ready.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить will после as long as. В придаточном условия нужен Present Simple (is).

prompt: Hai and his flatmates follow four simple rules at home. You may bring guests round for dinner ___ you tidy the kitchen afterwards. Nobody leaves the flat ___ all the windows are shut. Always keep a spare key in your bag ___ you lock yourself out. The hallway light always goes off at midnight without exception, ___ someone is still working in the kitchen.
explanation_ru: As long as вводит условие разрешения, unless — отрицательное условие («если не»), in case — предосторожность («на случай, если»), а even if — уступку («даже если»).

prompt: The café next to the clinic gives patients a cheaper cup of tea, but only when they show their appointment card at the counter.
options: Patients get a cheaper tea at the café even if they show their appointment card.
Patients get a cheaper tea at the café in case they show their appointment card.
Patients get a cheaper tea at the café provided they show their appointment card.
Patients get a cheaper tea at the café unless they show their appointment card.
explanation_ru: Provided точно передаёт обязательное условие скидки («при условии, что покажут карточку»). Even if, in case и unless меняют смысл правила.

prompt: No photos at all in this museum room, Yara says, ___ you turn off the flash.
explanation_ru: Запрет действует при любых обстоятельствах («даже если вы выключите вспышку»), поэтому нужен союз even if, а не as long as или unless.

prompt:
Aisha: Excuse me, is the rooftop pool open after sunset?
Clerk: We lock the gate at seven unless a guest (to ask) for a late swim before dinner.
Aisha: Great, please put my name down, and I will take a cardigan in case the wind (to get) cold up there.
Clerk: Of course — you are welcome to stay until nine as long as you (not / to make) any noise.
explanation_ru: После союзов unless, in case и as long as для реальных правил и будущих ситуаций используется Present Simple без will: asks, gets, do not make.

prompt: Diego agreed to cover my Friday closing shift ___ I let him have the entire weekend off.
explanation_ru: On condition that выражает строгое условие сделки («при условии, что»). Форма in case that неверна, а unless и even if искажают смысл договорённости.

prompt: Rina says visitors may go inside only if they (to leave) big bags outside.
explanation_ru: После only if в правиле употребляется Present Simple (leave) без will.

prompt: The choir conductor will not let Mei into the rehearsal hall, whether she arrives five minutes late or half an hour late. → Even if Mei arrives only five minutes late, …
answer: Even if Mei arrives only five minutes late, the choir conductor will not let her into the rehearsal hall.
accepted_answers: Even if Mei arrives only five minutes late, the choir conductor will not let her into the rehearsal hall.
Even if Mei arrives only five minutes late, the choir conductor won't let her into the rehearsal hall.
explanation_ru: Even if подчёркивает, что результат не изменится даже при минимальном опоздании; в главном предложении сохраняется will not let (won't let).

prompt: Oliver cannot start building the bird table with his class unless the wood doesn't arrive by Thursday.
answer: Oliver cannot start building the bird table with his class unless the wood arrives by Thursday.
accepted_answers: Oliver cannot start building the bird table with his class unless the wood arrives by Thursday.
Oliver can't start building the bird table with his class unless the wood arrives by Thursday.
explanation_ru: Частая ошибка — двойное отрицание с unless (unless ... doesn't). Союз unless уже означает «если не», поэтому нужен утвердительный глагол arrives.

prompt: Whether the supplier (to confirm) the delivery date today or not, Ji-ho is preparing a backup order in case the laptops (not / to arrive) on time.
explanation_ru: После whether ... or not и in case для будущего используется Present Simple без will: confirms и do not arrive.

prompt: I'll sign up for the Sunday running club ___ the stadium lights stay on after dark.
explanation_ru: Only if задаёт единственное условие записи в клуб («только если свет останется включённым»). Частая ошибка — путать only if с even if («даже если»).

prompt: Hi everyone, Talia here with a quick reminder about our family chat. You can post pictures of the kids ___ both parents say yes first. Please never share those photos outside this group, ___ a close friend asks to see them. I have pinned the rules at the top ___ any new relatives forget. Let me know ___ you agree with this or not.
explanation_ru: Provided вводит условие разрешения, even if — уступку при запрете, in case — предосторожность, а whether сочетается с or not в косвенном вопросе.

prompt: Suppose the airline (not / to confirm) the direct flight in time — what will Carmen offer her winter clients?
explanation_ru: В главной части стоит will (реальное будущее), поэтому после suppose нужен Present Simple (does not confirm), а не will.

prompt: Sara and Matteo do not mind hosting study partners in their Bologna flat, as long as nobody makes a sound between eight and ten.
answer: Sara and Matteo do not mind hosting study partners in their Bologna flat, as long as nobody makes a sound between eight and ten.
accepted_answers: Sara and Matteo do not mind hosting study partners in their Bologna flat, as long as nobody makes a sound between eight and ten.
explanation_ru: Предложение полностью верно: после as long as стоит Present Simple (makes), а отрицательное подлежащее nobody не требует дополнительного отрицания.

prompt: Notice to all Manchester community gardeners: our shared tap is under heavy use this dry month. You may water your vegetable beds on weekday evenings provided you (to finish) before eight o'clock. Please keep a full watering can beside your shed in case the water pressure (to drop) during busy hours. Nobody should leave a hose running unattended, even if the soil (to look) completely dry. Thank you for helping us keep the garden fair for everyone.
explanation_ru: После provided, in case и even if в правилах и предупреждениях ставится настоящее время без will: finish (или have finished), drops и looks.

prompt: Mikkel has saved a copy of the old homepage on his drive ___ the client rejects the new layout next week.
explanation_ru: Перед придаточным предложением для меры предосторожности используется in case без that. Типичные ошибки — калька in case that или предлог in case of (он требует существительного).

prompt: Divya can get a cat if the flat owner agrees. → Divya can get a cat as long as …
answer: Divya can get a cat as long as the flat owner agrees.
accepted_answers: Divya can get a cat as long as the flat owner agrees.
explanation_ru: Союз as long as заменяет if, подчёркивая обязательное условие, а глагол остаётся в Present Simple (agrees).

prompt: Alfie is not sure if his neighbour will arrive late, so he buys an extra bag of ice now just to be safe.
options: Alfie buys extra ice in case his neighbour arrives late.
Alfie buys extra ice unless his neighbour arrives late.
Alfie buys extra ice in case his neighbour will arrive late.
Alfie buys extra ice as long as his neighbour arrives late.
explanation_ru: Действие «на всякий случай» передаётся через in case + Present Simple (arrives). Вариант с will после in case грамматически неверен, а unless и as long as меняют смысл.

prompt: Filipe gives the puppy no treats ___ it sits quietly by the door.
explanation_ru: Unless («если не») заменяет if ... not: щенок не получит угощения, если не сядет спокойно. Остальные союзы не передают это правило.

prompt: Mislav happily makes all the dumpling dough every evening, so long as his cousin (to clean) the kitchen and (to lock) up.
explanation_ru: После so long as в регулярной договорённости оба однородных глагола стоят в Present Simple (cleans и locks).

prompt: Good news for village surgery patients: the local gym offers one free session ___ you bring a signed note from your nurse. You cannot use the weights room ___ a trainer checks your plan first. Please wear clean trainers and bring water ___ you feel thirsty during the class. The free offer applies this month ___ you are a new gym visitor or not.
explanation_ru: On condition that вводит условие акции, unless — ограничение («если не»), in case — предосторожность, а whether образует конструкцию whether ... or not.

prompt: Florence lets visiting researchers handle the sixteenth-century castle maps, but only if they wear thin cotton gloves throughout their visit. → Florence lets visiting researchers handle the sixteenth-century castle maps on condition …
answer: Florence lets visiting researchers handle the sixteenth-century castle maps on condition that they wear thin cotton gloves throughout their visit.
accepted_answers: Florence lets visiting researchers handle the sixteenth-century castle maps on condition that they wear thin cotton gloves throughout their visit.
Florence lets visiting researchers handle the sixteenth-century castle maps on condition they wear thin cotton gloves throughout their visit.
Florence lets visiting researchers handle the sixteenth-century castle maps on condition that they wear thin cotton gloves throughout their visit
explanation_ru: On condition (that) используется в официальных правилах вместо only if; после него сохраняется Present Simple (wear).

prompt: Xiaoli is taking an extra towel to the rooftop pool in case the hotel desk will run out before sunset.
answer: Xiaoli is taking an extra towel to the rooftop pool in case the hotel desk runs out before sunset.
accepted_answers: Xiaoli is taking an extra towel to the rooftop pool in case the hotel desk runs out before sunset.
Xiaoli's taking an extra towel to the rooftop pool in case the hotel desk runs out before sunset.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить will после in case. Для возможного будущего события после in case нужен Present Simple (runs out).

prompt:
Manager: We would love to offer you the café job starting next Monday.
Applicant: Thank you, I really want to take it, provided the timetable (to leave) my Sunday mornings free.
Manager: We can arrange that unless someone on the weekend team (to fall) ill at the last minute.
Applicant: Suppose that (to happen) — will I get another day off during the week?
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о реальных условиях будущей работы, поэтому после provided, unless и suppose (при will в вопросе) ставится Present Simple: leaves, falls, happens.

prompt: Hatice keeps the small locker key in her zipped pocket because she might drop it in the gallery. → Hatice keeps the small locker key in her zipped pocket in case …
answer: Hatice keeps the small locker key in her zipped pocket in case she drops it in the gallery.
accepted_answers: Hatice keeps the small locker key in her zipped pocket in case she drops it in the gallery.
explanation_ru: In case передаёт меру предосторожности («на случай, если выронит»), а глагол после него ставится в Present Simple (drops) без might или will.

prompt: There is no point booking the private karaoke room in the city centre ___ by six o'clock, because the deposit is not refundable.
options: unless at least four friends will confirm
unless at least four friends don't confirm
in case at least four friends confirm
unless at least four friends confirm
explanation_ru: После unless нужен утвердительный Present Simple (confirm). Варианты с will и don't — частые ошибки, а in case меняет смысл условия на предосторожность.

prompt: Bruno plans to set up his balcony weather station this weekend, ___ the missing part arrives by Friday. He bought a waterproof box ___ heavy rain reaches the cables. The little screen will stay easy to read, ___ bright midday sun shines straight onto it. He does not know yet ___ the sensor will measure wind speed accurately or not.
explanation_ru: Providing задаёт условие запуска, in case — защиту на случай дождя, even if — уступку («даже если»), а whether используется перед альтернативой с or not.

prompt: Réka and Bence agreed to share one flea market stall and split all their weekend earnings equally, no matter whose table brings in more sales.
options: Réka and Bence will split the weekend earnings equally in case one of them sells more than the other.
Réka and Bence will split the weekend earnings equally whether Réka sells more than Bence or not.
Réka and Bence will split the weekend earnings equally unless one of them sells more than the other.
Réka and Bence will split the weekend earnings equally only if Réka sells more than Bence.
explanation_ru: Конструкция whether ... or not передаёт идею «независимо от того, кто продаст больше». Остальные союзы (in case, unless, only if) искажают суть договорённости.

prompt: Do we really receive a free pot of tea at the café, providing each chess player (to keep) their stamp card and (to order) a snack on their third visit?
explanation_ru: После providing (при условии, что) с подлежащим each chess player оба глагола ставятся в Present Simple единственного числа (keeps и orders).

prompt: Our small app team in Tainan will release the update next week ___ the main server passes tonight's speed test. We cannot launch earlier ___ every payment error is fixed. The engineers have prepared a backup plan ___ users face sudden crashes after midnight. Still, we will run our Friday demo for partners, ___ the public release has to wait a few days.
explanation_ru: Only if задаёт строгое условие релиза, unless — запрет до исправления ошибок, in case — план на случай сбоев, а even if — уступку («даже если релиз отложат»).
